channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ross Fire surpasses 80,000 acres, prompts evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has consumed over 80,000 acres in Palo Pinto and Jack counties, leading to evacuations, road closures, and school disruptions.

item.title: Arrest made in fatal shooting of influencer during livestream
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, dressed as a delivery worker, was participating in a social media challenge with two friends when he was fatally shot.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz agreement with Oman puts ball back in U.S. court
item.description: As U.S. economic pressure bites, Iran touts a plan with Oman to get ships moving through the Strait of Hormuz and suggests the next move is Trump's.

item.title: Republicans face midterm verdict as Iran war drags on longer than Trump promised
item.description: The Iran war has reshaped the rapidly approaching midterm elections
